implementation: Existing rules/progression.js gate, levelGate, exposureDecision, exposureScheduling and strengthDecision remain authoritative. Rows describe those executable rules; they do not replace them.
evidenceCaution: Research-informed programming, not validated automatic medical clearance. Exact ladders, spacing, repetition of exposures and numeric safety safeguards are product rules.

rows.criteria: Completed prescribed sets at top of range, RPE 1–8, good quality, no symptoms, confirmed feedback, tolerated next morning, green readiness.
rows.automaticAdjustment: Prescribe smallest practical load increase; preserve sets/reps and load conventions.
holdRules: Re-entry review or missing reviewed dose
